key_insight: OPD generally trails GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP with an external teacher, but efficiently consolidates domain-specific GRPO experts into one student.
engineering_relevance: Training domain specialists with GRPO and then consolidating them via multi-teacher OPD can reduce compute for a multi-domain model versus joint GRPO training.
method: Compare reverse-KL OPD and GRPO using held-out accuracy versus training FLOPs.
Vary task difficulty, model size, domain, optimization settings, and teacher source.
Distill per-domain GRPO checkpoints into a single student using multi-teacher OPD.
evidence_signal: Self-checkpoint OPD recovered math accuracy with 50× fewer distillation FLOPs, while specialist training plus distillation matched joint GRPO on a two-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.
watch_item: The 50× result excludes teacher training; single-domain distillation adds compute, and external-teacher OPD often inflates response length.
paper_title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
